description: This file contains extension methods for NodeAppModel that perform normalization of watch notification parameters and actions, including trimming strings and setting default actions based on notification kind and prompt ID.

methods.name: normalizeWatchNotifyParams
methods.description: Normalizes the parameters for a watch notification, standardizing string fields, setting priority and risk, and normalizing actions.

methods.name: normalizeWatchActions
methods.description: Processes a list of actions, trimming their fields, filtering invalid entries, and providing default actions based on notification kind and prompt ID.

methods.name: normalizedWatchRisk
methods.description: Determines the normalized risk level based on input risk and priority.

methods.name: normalizedWatchPriority
methods.description: Determines the normalized priority based on input priority and risk.

methods.name: trimmedOrNil
methods.description: Utility method that trims whitespace and returns nil if the string is empty.
